title: nan
authors: Ramirez R.; Lin T.; Kryzia D.; Luo Z.; Faraj N.; Espana D.; Thakkar T.; Bhandari S.; Raheja A.; Chowdhury M.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV SLAM framework with sensor fusion, visual-inertial odometry, and object detection for indoor navigation and search-and-rescue in GPS-denied environments, with simulation and flight tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
